S=\int 2\pi y\,\text{d}s.
$$

$$
\text{d}s=\sqrt{1+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore, we will use

$$
S=2\pi {\int }_{{x}_{1}}^{{x}_{2}}y\sqrt{1+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

We are told that the limits of integration are from ${x}_{1}=0$ to ${x}_{2}=1.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x-{x}^{4})=1-4{x}^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =2\pi {\int }_{{x}_{1}}^{{x}_{2}}y\sqrt{1+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{1}(x-{x}^{4})\sqrt{1+{(1-4{x}^{3})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{1}(x-{x}^{4})\sqrt{2-8{x}^{3}+16{x}^{6}}\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}

$$

$$
S=\int 2\pi y\,\text{d}s.
$$

Since we're given a curve in the form $y=f(x),$ we have 

$$
\text{d}s=\sqrt{1+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore, we will use

$$
S=2\pi {\int }_{{x}_{1}}^{{x}_{2}}y\sqrt{1+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

We are told that the limits of integration are from ${x}_{1}=0$ to ${x}_{2}=3.$ 

Computing the derivative, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\sqrt{x}-\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3/2})=\frac{1-x}{2\sqrt{x}}\,⇒\,{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}=\frac{1-2x+{x}^{2}}{4x}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =2\pi {\int }_{{x}_{1}}^{{x}_{2}}y\sqrt{1+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{3}(\sqrt{x}-\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3/2})\sqrt{1+\frac{1-2x+{x}^{2}}{4x}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{3}(\sqrt{x}-\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3/2})\sqrt{\frac{(x+1)^{2}}{4x}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{\sqrt{x}(3-x)}{3}(\frac{x+1}{2\sqrt{x}})\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{\pi }{3}{\int }_{0}^{3}(3-x)(x+1)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{\pi }{3}{\int }_{0}^{3}(3+2x-{x}^{2})\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\pi {[3x+{x}^{2}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{0}^{3} \\  & =\frac{\pi }{3}\cdot 9 \\  & =3\pi .\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-a8e6cbf3-7b66-5401-9a6d-5259b70ef31f"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-a8e6cbf3-7b66-5401-9a6d-5259b70ef31f" :answer-field/id #uuid "a8e6cbf3-7b66-5401-9a6d-5259b70ef31f" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-5f5eaa2f-7b67-59fb-ac74-96008538d1e1" :answer-field/choices ["answer-422bd46c-effb-5d0b-904d-3ee35544d973" "answer-5f5eaa2f-7b67-59fb-ac74-96008538d1e1" "answer-53183f8e-14d6-52c2-9f1a-70be683a7846" "answer-a548f782-4430-54c1-9ade-29c1fd806b51" "answer-c743a931-9156-5119-af96-2e6b26ebadfb"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-422bd46c-effb-5d0b-904d-3ee35544d973" :answer/id #uuid "422bd46c-effb-5d0b-904d-3ee35544d973" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "12\pi " :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-5f5eaa2f-7b67-59fb-ac74-96008538d1e1" :answer/id #uuid "5f5eaa2f-7b67-59fb-ac74-96008538d1e1" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3\pi " :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-53183f8e-14d6-52c2-9f1a-70be683a7846" :answer/id #uuid "53183f8e-14d6-52c2-9f1a-70be683a7846" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{2\pi }{3}" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a548f782-4430-54c1-9ade-29c1fd806b51" :answer/id #uuid "a548f782-4430-54c1-9ade-29c1fd806b51" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{4\pi }{3}" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-c743a931-9156-5119-af96-2e6b26ebadfb" :answer/id #uuid "c743a931-9156-5119-af96-2e6b26ebadfb" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{\pi }{6}" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186129339 :activity/expected-seconds 1260.0 :db/ensure [:activity/validate]}]

$$

$$
